title: Vibecoding a 3D Souls-like bow-gun shooter in Godot 4
author: Sad_Network3765
selftext:
Solo project (Sinfall) in Godot 4.7

Stack is a hybrid mix of Godot 4.7, Blender + CC0 textures, Meshy, ElevenLabs, and AI coding agents - using AI where it speeds up iteration while keeping tight manual/automated quality control over the final feel.

Curious what feels strong and what still looks rough to fresh eyes!

replies.author: Sad_Network3765
replies.body: that effect is very hard to make, cost me many rounds of iteration, but worth!

comments.author: MaksRengi
comments.body: How long does it take to develop a game like this with Godot and AI?

replies.author: Sad_Network3765
replies.body: this is still very far from finish for a good souls like game, this genre require more time to develop. but i have started this project few weeks ago. expect very long sessions of manual adjusting, animating, audio picking and generating etc.

replies.author: MaksRengi
replies.body:
Impressive work, good luck with it.  
Souls likes are a pain in the ass to polish and test, but worth it

replies.author: Sad_Network3765
replies.body: ngl, feels like i learnt a lot on agentic automation and game dev tech, gotta be a good learning opportunity.

replies.author: MaksRengi
replies.body: agree, back in the day you had to read half of Stack Overflow, Code Monkey and Unity docs just to fix one thing. now it's way easier, and it's cool you're using it to actually learn and not just to ship stuff

comments.author: Trick_Study7766
comments.body: Looks like all enemy attacks can be dodged by jumping backwards? You would probably want to fix that as it gets repetitive. That was one of the people’s complaints for Dark Souls 2 🙃

replies.author: Sad_Network3765
replies.body: yea, so i will make it more brutal
